author: Wickerman
text_post: Every man is his own sovereign state. A sovereign state with clearly defined borders which admit only those things that the man specifically agrees may pass through. Those self-defined borders are sacrosanct, and supersede all other coda and dogma that foreign states, such as the Democratic People’s Republic of Feminism, may attempt to impose on the Male Sovereign State. Each Sovereign state first declares its independence from all foreign powers, draws up a constitution that clearly defines the rights and obligations of that Sovereign state, and enforces those rights on all legal inhabitants of said Sovereign State. The first Amendment to the constitution of the sovereign state reads: No foreign state or individual shall infringe on the right of the Sovereign State to go its own way. No foreign mores or traditions shall limit the rights and freedoms of said sovereign state. The Sovereign State is Sacrosanct. by Wickerman
